title: Dark History of Nalanda University - Ashutosh Pratihast | Why Bakhtiyar Khilji Destroyed Nalanda?
description:
Dark History of Nalanda University - Ashutosh Pratihast
This video delves into the rich history of Nalanda University, exploring why India was hailed as the world's guru. Nalanda University, an ancient seat of learning, holds profound significance in India's cultural heritage and global academia.
As Narendra Modi Inaugurated Nalanda University On 19th June 2024, we're one step closer to becoming World Leader again. & this is a real good news!

Nalanda University, located in present-day Bihar, flourished as a premier center of learning from the 5th to the 12th century CE, attracting scholars and students from across the world. This video sheds light on the academic excellence, intellectual discourse, and multicultural environment that characterized Nalanda during its zenith.

The narrative explores various aspects of Nalanda, including its curriculum, renowned scholars, and contributions to diverse fields such as philosophy, mathematics, astronomy, medicine, and Buddhist studies. It also discusses the decline of Nalanda, attributed to factors like invasions and the decline of patronage.

Through engaging storytelling and historical insights, viewers gain a deeper understanding of Nalanda's legacy and its enduring impact on education and intellectual pursuits worldwide. By unraveling the mysteries of Nalanda, the video invites viewers to reflect on India's historical role as a global hub of knowledge and wisdom.

This informative video serves as a tribute to Nalanda's illustrious past and highlights its relevance in contemporary discourse on education, culture, and intellectual exchange.
